name: MCP Platform Maintenance: Missing Credential Rejected
description: Issue #7: VerifyMcpSecret must actually reject requests that omit the X-Station-Mcp-Secret header, proving HUB_MCP_SECRET is enforced in the recording environment rather than silently bypassed by the APP_ENV=local empty-credential allowance. This targets DELETE (the side-effecting clear operation) with the maintenance flag pre-set, and asserts before == after in Redis (key still present, value unchanged) to prove the rejected request had no effect. Known limitation: set_at/until are normalized to a fixed placeholder (<ISO8601+08:00>) before comparison, so this scenario cannot detect a bug where the 403 path still silently rewrites set_at/until while leaving the rest of the value/shape unchanged — before/after would both normalize to the same placeholder and look identical either way.
